page.layout: One printed title page, one column of centred lines, with a few smaller lines below. Show-through from the reverse side is visible in the middle and lower part. No running head, page number or catchword.
page.notes: The title is set in large capitals and lower-case roman type, mostly faint and partly cut off at the top right. Most lines cannot be read with certainty. The grey marks in the centre and lower middle are show-through from the verso, and the faint lines near the bottom are show-through as well. The small stamp at the lower left is a library digitiser's mark and was left out.
